title: Modality specific U-Net variants for biomedical image segmentation: a survey

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Modality specific U-Net variants for biomedical image segmentation: a survey》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】With the advent of advancements in deep learning approaches, such as deep convolution neural network, residual neural network, adversarial network; U-Net architectures are most widely utilized in biomedical image segmentation to address the automation in identification and detection of the target regions or sub-regions.
